discovery_prompt: Report a sidewalk_goods Profile hit when one or more placed cardboard cartons are clearly visible.
grounding_prompt: Locate each placed cardboard carton independently and return its original-image pixel box [x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max].

questions.prompt: Evaluate only the highlighted carton. The signed synthetic camera calibration covers $SIDEWALK_ZONE, in original 1536 by 1024 pixel coordinates (top-left origin). Evaluate whether the carton's ground-contact footprint overlaps this pedestrian zone. A stacked carton is assessable only when its support to the ground is visually unambiguous and the supporting footprint overlaps the zone. A raised carton seen against this rectangle is not sufficient. Answer occupies_sidewalk when physical overlap is clear, does_not_occupy_sidewalk when clearly disjoint, or insufficient_visibility when ground contact, support, or overlap is ambiguous. Assess visual geometry only.
questions.region_prompt: For the carton at the supplied coordinates, find its visible floor contact or trace its support visibly to the floor. The pedestrian zone is $SIDEWALK_ZONE in the same coordinates. Use occupies_sidewalk for clear physical overlap, does_not_occupy_sidewalk for clear disjoint floor contact, and insufficient_visibility for uncertain contact, support or overlap. Image box overlap alone is insufficient.
